_comment: E9 (MODEL-EXPERIMENTS.md): the eleven dog intents as Gemma 4 native tools. name = intent; parameters = the fields dog.gbnf admits for that intent (the dog prompt's table: LOCAL_ACTION the body fields, NAVIGATE goal/tag_id, QUERY/FIND/FOLLOW target, constraints on the three that take a place). $defs are expanded by tools/e9-tools.py, which renders the declarations, grammar/dog-tools.gbnf and the T prompts from this file.

attributes.description: color, size or material when the person states them

place.description: a thing in the world, open vocabulary: description is the person's words as said

goal.description: where to go, open vocabulary: description is the person's words as said; AprilTags are type TAG

constraints.description: spatial phrases, each a relation to a reference

tools.name: LOCAL_ACTION
tools.description: an immediate body action: stand, sit, lie down, stretch, shake or give paw, turn, move a step or a short distance

tools.name: QUERY
tools.description: a question about what the robot sees or knows; does not move the robot

tools.name: NAVIGATE
tools.description: go to a goal the robot can resolve: an object, region, room, landmark, or an AprilTag (goal type TAG plus tag_id; no tag_id when no number is said)

tag_id.description: the AprilTag number, only when said

tools.name: FIND
tools.description: search for something, exploring if it has not been seen yet

tools.name: FOLLOW
tools.description: follow a moving target, usually a person

tools.name: DATE
tools.description: a question about the calendar: the date or the day

tools.name: CHITCHAT
tools.description: a greeting or a social remark to the robot

tools.name: UNKNOWN
tools.description: anything the robot genuinely cannot or must not do
